name: blueprint/job-tracker
description: Applications as a board with follow-up events: log the application, board a task, schedule the follow-up, record the outcome either way
recipe: log the application with the posting text -> classify fit (strong/medium/long-shot) -> board a task and schedule the follow-up event -> outcome: done or failed with the result field saying why
pitfalls: a rejected application is a failed task with a result - the record stays
cancel the follow-up event when the outcome lands
posting text in the record makes the fit check falsifiable
